label: Total Loans Outstanding
description: Sum of all loans on the books at quarter end

label: Auto Loans — Indirect
description: Auto loans originated through a dealer (Origence)

label: Delinquent Loans 60+ DPD
description: Loans past due 60 days or more

label: Provision for Loan Losses
description: Period expense recorded against P&L for expected credit losses

label: Allowance for Credit Losses — Beginning
description: Beginning balance of CECL allowance for the period

label: Allowance for Credit Losses — Ending
description: Ending balance of CECL allowance for the period

label: Loans Charged Off
description: Principal written off during the period

label: Total Assets
description: Sum of all earning assets and cash
formula_notes: Total Loans + Investments + Cash + Other Assets

label: Total Net Worth
description: Regulatory net worth (capital + reserves + undivided earnings)
formula_notes: Configured as 9.5% of total assets in synth model

label: Net Worth Ratio
description: Net worth divided by total assets
